title: The millpond
logline: The millpond in 1994 with logs still in it, a man on a boom with a pike pole, the water black. Christmas Day in the box; nothing in the page says so. The mill has six months.

panels.composition: A millpond crowded with floating logs, a man on a log boom with a pike pole from behind, the mill's wall and stack beyond, black water, gulls. Era I spotting.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, in the Era I manner, heavy black spotting brought back on purpose, a millpond crowded with floating logs and a man on a boom with a long pike pole seen from behind, a mill wall and stack beyond, black water and gulls, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: Six months left. The pond full.
